name: Young & Minted: I Won the Lottery
original_name: Young & Minted: I Won the Lottery
overview: Olivia Lee travels the UK, seeking out the young people who hit the jackpot and became lottery millionaires. But how have they splashed their cash and have their lucky numbers changed them as people? From a brand new set of double Ds to a 10-month bender around the world, find out what happens when everyday folk get filthy rich overnight.
